methodology.world: Natural disasters and full foreign strategy; paid public commands and actual battles with AI tactics, mandatory battle-resolution cost rules, normal rest and save validation

methodology.exclusions: Initial exploration, repair-before controls (12x108 turns), strategy probes and initial matrix are excluded from final counts.
methodology.metrics: Post-battle snapshots strictly exclude the battle-turn row recorded before the battle; zero central troops also count stopped plans.
